verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform, so headless or API-driven automation is a fair axis to judge it on. However, the evidence describes only human-mediated workflows: case managers, attorneys, in-platform tracking and one-click meetings. No API, CLI or CI-oriented interface is documented, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
